description: G1 regression check: run the SAME entry script, image and branch as the X1 task but with --robot g1, to prove the upstream G1 code path (mjlab's G1 entity + G1_ACTION_SCALE + TRACKED_BODIES + the 'tracked' joint-weight table + MotionLibrary) still executes end to end after the X1 changes. 40 iterations, 512 envs. NOTE: it is fed motions/x1_cmu_walk.npz because the repository ships no G1 library (data/ is gitignored); the reference is therefore X1 data interpreted in G1 joint order, so the returns are meaningless -- what this run tests is that the path runs (config builds, scene compiles, iterations advance, checkpoint is written), not G1 tracking quality.
